documents.text: William Carrier (footballer) William Carrier (1887 – after 1911) was an English professional footballer who played in the Football League for Birmingham. Carrier was born in Ashington, Northumberland, but brought up in South Wales. He was on the books of Manchester United, but returned to junior football in Merthyr Tydfil without playing for United's first team. Because of his Welsh upbringing his name was suggested for selection for the Wales national football team until he was found to be English-born. Carrier signed for Birmingham in September 1909.
